text.text: SF-PCA: Scalable and Privacy-Preserving Federated PCA
Workflow over s data providers: local cleartext computation + MHE encrypted space + interactive collaboration.

Invariant
raw A~_i never leaves DP_i
no pooled plaintext matrix

Security model
semi-honest DPs
secure if one DP honest

Step 1 Setup
DKeyGen: pk, evks
agree p,w,psi,alpha,rho,Pi

Step 2 Mean Calculation
aggregate local sums
produce encrypted o

Step 3 Random Projection
local A~_i x Pi_i
encrypt + aggregate P

Step 4 Power Iterations
increase spectral gap
QR orthogonalization: QRT

Precomp branch
precompute G_i = A~_i^T A~_i
reuse G_i each iteration
fewer multiplications

Seq branch
sequentially multiply
P by A~_i and A~_i^T
no explicit covariance

Key optimization
lazy mean-centering
keep A~_i cleartext
correct mean shift with encrypted o

Step 5 Reduction
small symmetric Z
lazy mean-centering reused

Step 6 Eigendecomposition
Eigen on encrypted Z
iterative QRT + matmul

Step 7 Reconstruction
compute encrypted PCs W
final power iteration + QRT

Step 8 Projection
each DP projects local A~_i^T
obtain encrypted A'_i

optional DKeySwitch
re-encrypt or decrypt
to designated entities
